title: Confluence Scanner AI — trading scanner for crypto, stocks, ETFs & forex
author: Zealousideal-Menu296
selftext:
I just launched Confluence Scanner AI and I'm looking for traders willing to test it and give me honest feedback.

It combines Volume Profile, POC, VWAP, FVGs and ATR-based trade planning.

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.base6a5ce88dc0cb5ae4a39ac6c9.app

I'd especially appreciate feedback from anyone who actively trades.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: I'd test the confluence before the app. take the scanner's signals over a stretch you didn't build it on and check whether the five inputs agreeing beats VWAP alone. most of the time the extra layers just cut the number of trades without changing the ones that remain, and you only find that out by running it forward on paper. that is exactly what I built Quantradin for, it lives at quantradin.com, free and paper only, US stocks and ETFs, so the crypto and forex legs you'd have to test elsewhere.

replies.author: Zealousideal-Menu296
replies.body: That's actually interesting. I'll check out QuanTradin and compare the results against the Confluence Scanner methodology. I'm particularly interested in whether the additional confluence layers improve the quality of the remaining trades rather than simply reducing the number of signals. Thanks for sharing it.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: the number to compare is average R per trade on the survivors against the full set, same window. if the layers only shrink the count and the average stays put, they are a filter on volume, not on quality.
